name: funds
title: Funds
deviation_note: Scope agreed on 2026-10-23: Funds load (L3/L4), Margin data load (L14), RAM (R2), data per open (L15) and CPU/data over a 2-minute idle session (C1/C4, live_ticks set only to enable that session; the screen has no live prices). 3 runs each; timings with timing.py. Cold start and phone metrics already covered by the Portfolio run. Add/withdraw money timings are out of the agent (real transactions). In scope: RISE, INDmoney, Groww, Kotak Neo. L14 (Margin) only exists in RISE, so it is reported for RISE and not scored.
offline_items: Cold launch in airplane mode → Funds shows the last known balance
Cached data shows a 'last updated' time or stale indicator
Network lost while on Funds → balance stays visible (no blank screen or crash)
Clear offline message or banner shown
Auto-refresh on reconnect (no manual pull needed)
No forced re-login or PIN after reconnect
Add funds page opens offline or explains why not
Cached balance is clearly not presented as live
No crash or ANR during offline ↔ online transitions
data_items: UPI / netbanking options on Add funds
notes: READ-ONLY: accounts belong to other people. Open Funds and Margin and go Back. Never type an amount, pick a payment method or submit. L14 = Funds → Margin until margin values are shown.
_todo: Confirm each app's Funds path, the Add funds / Withdraw / Margin entries with /benchmark-module funds before the first run.

app_notes.RISE: Funds opens on the Add Funds tab (amount pre-filled, keypad open, 'Add ₹100' button at the bottom: never tap it). Tabs: Add Funds | Withdraw Funds | Margin. L5 = from Withdraw tab tap Add Funds tab; L16 = tap Withdraw Funds tab; L14 = tap Margin tab.
